policy_rule: Strict separation between empirical observations, photo-estimates, and literature assumptions. Level 2 and Level 3 canopy parameters are NOT assigned during this task.

Category_A_Observed_or_Census_Reported.description: Empirical municipal records from BBMP July 2026 census.
fields: local_coordinates (x, y meters relative to Church Street origin)

Category_B_Photo_Estimated.description: Approximate geometric proportions estimated from uncalibrated street photographs (KartaView 2020, Commons 2018/2024).
Category_B_Photo_Estimated.coverage: 6/6 core trees, 2/8 context trees (T06, T07). 6/8 context trees MISSING.

Category_C_Literature_Assumed.description: Biophysical and radiative parameters from urban microclimate literature (e.g. SOLWEIG, ENVI-met database). NOT ASSIGNED in interim stage.

Category_D_Missing.description: Parameters requiring on-site field measurements, laser rangefinder / LiDAR scanning, or recent field verification.

rationale: Physics solver requires calibrated 3D canopy geometry and validated transmissivity. Uncalibrated photo estimates must not be ingested into ray tracing without explicit researcher approval.
